subject: Television & Streaming
title: Black Mirror and Tech Anxiety
description: One-minute skill: Black Mirror and Tech Anxiety.

hook.text: Black Mirror's first episode featured a prime minister forced to commit an unspeakable act on live television.

buildup.text: Charlie Brooker created an anthology where each episode explores a different nightmare about technology.

discovery.text: The show hit a nerve because its horrors felt possible.

twist.text: Some predictions came true. China launched a social credit system. Deepfakes became real.

climax.text: Black Mirror became shorthand for tech dystopia. When a real innovation feels creepy, people say 'that's Black Mirror.'

punchline.text: The scariest sci-fi show was barely fiction at all.

quiz.question: What is the central theme of Black Mirror episodes?
options: The dark consequences of technology on society
